game.q: “i believe” and “help my unbelief,” in one breath. why doesn’t Jesus send him away?
opts: honest faith can hold doubt too
he rehearsed it the whole way there

wrong.grammar: it was a mess, honestly. that’s what made it real.
wrong.script: no script. just a desperate dad telling the truth.

game.right: YES. he didn’t fake being sure. he brought what he had, and asked for help with the rest.

end.line: a dad who wasn’t sure said so out loud, and Jesus took his prayer anyway.

cliff.s1: a king on the run says angry things to God.
cliff.s2: and those angry words ended up in the bible.

share: he wasn’t sure. he said so, out loud. five honest words on infinite hill
